heading: Our suite of eCommerce platforms and technologies
text2: KeyDevs Technologies has a large pool of developers who build online stores on the top eCommerce platforms and frameworks.

items.title: WooCommerce Development
items.text: WooCommerce turns WordPress into a flexible store. It is a strong choice for brands that want fast setup, easy content control and a huge range of plugins, without giving up customization.

items.title: Magento and PHP Stores
items.text: For large catalogs and complex pricing, PHP-based platforms such as Magento give you enterprise-grade features and full control over how your store works.

items.title: Laravel Custom Stores
items.text: Laravel is ideal when you need a fully custom store or marketplace with clean architecture, strong security and easy API integrations.

items.title: NodeJS Commerce Backends
items.text: NodeJS powers real-time inventory, live order tracking and headless commerce APIs that serve your website and mobile apps from one backend.

items.title: Angular Storefronts
items.text: Angular storefronts give shoppers a smooth, app-like experience with instant page transitions and rich product filtering.

items.title: CodeIgniter Stores
items.text: CodeIgniter is lightweight and fast, a great fit for small and mid-sized stores that need to launch quickly on a lean budget.
